Name: HERO_PARAM_ST
Description: The playable heroes (Nightfarers): menu texts, portraits and icons, the HeroStatusParam rows, skill and Ultimate Art charge values. Row ID = hero number.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 6 of 10 heroes.

Fields.Name: Is Selectable
Fields.Description: Set: the hero is listed in the hero archive dialog's hero list (it may still need its unlock flag). Clear: left out of that list. Retail: set on every hero.

Fields.Name: Menu Hero Index
Fields.Description: Which hero picture and status graph the menus show for this hero (hero status, hero list, character creation). Retail: the hero number (1-10).

Fields.Name: Portrait ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon of the hero's full portrait (menus and HUD). Retail: 41000 + 10 x (hero - 1).

Fields.Name: Icon Portrait ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon of the hero's small portrait. Retail: 41600 + 10 x (hero - 1).

Fields.Name: Character Unlock Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be on for the hero to be available. 0 or -1: always available. Retail: 6031 Duchess, 6037 Revenant, 6038 Scholar, 6039 Undertaker; 0 for the others.

Fields.Name: Name ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the hero's name.

Fields.Name: Character Skill Title ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the name of the hero's character skill.

Fields.Name: Character Skill Summary ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the short summary of the hero's character skill.

Fields.Name: Character Skill Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon of the hero's character skill (menus and the skill HUD).

Fields.Name: Ultimate Art Title ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the name of the hero's Ultimate Art.

Fields.Name: Ultimate Art Summary ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the short summary of the hero's Ultimate Art.

Fields.Name: Ultimate Art Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon of the hero's Ultimate Art (menus and the HUD).

Fields.Name: Background Description ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the hero's background story.

Fields.Name: Random Value 1
Fields.Description: One of Random Value 1-3 (values below 0 are skipped) is picked at random for each party member playing this hero and kept with the member's spawn position. What it selects is not established. Retail 63500 on every hero.

Fields.Name: Random Value 2
Fields.Description: See Random Value 1. Retail 63510 on every hero.

Fields.Name: Random Value 3
Fields.Description: See Random Value 1. Retail 63520 on every hero.

Fields.Name: Hero Status ID
Fields.Description: First HeroStatusParam row of this hero. The hero's level picks among that row and the rows with the following IDs (see HeroStatusParam Total Level). Retail: hero number x 10000.

Fields.Name: Ultimate Art Charge
Fields.Description: Ultimate Art gauge charge needed to use the Ultimate Art (the gauge's maximum). Retail: 999.99 on every hero.

Fields.Name: Character Ability Cooldown
Fields.Description: Cooldown of the character skill in seconds. Retail: 0 (Revenant, Recluse, Executor) to 14.

Fields.Name: Character Skill Usage Count
Fields.Description: Character skill uses that can be stored; the hero starts with this many. Only the low byte is used (0-255). Retail: 1 on every hero.

Fields.Name: Passive Ability Title ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the name of the hero's passive ability.

Fields.Name: Passive Ability Summary ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the short summary of the hero's passive ability.

Fields.Name: Passive Ability Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon of the hero's passive ability (menus and the controls guide).

Fields.Name: Small Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon of the hero used in small item-style menu elements. Retail: 41130 + (hero - 1).

Fields.Name: Character Skill Description ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the full description of the hero's character skill.

Fields.Name: Ultimate Art Description ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the full description of the hero's Ultimate Art.

Fields.Name: Passive Ability Description ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text with the full description of the hero's passive ability.

Fields.Name: Default Weapon Type Discovery
Fields.Description: Weapon Type Discovery value used in this hero's item rolls when no "Dormant Power Helps Discover..." effect sets one (those effects use weapon type numbers). Retail: 1000 + 100 x hero number (1100-2000); what these hero values select is not established.

Fields.Name: Passive Ability Guide Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text shown on the passive ability page of the hero's controls guide.

Fields.Name: Character Skill Guide Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text shown on the character skill page of the hero's controls guide. Executor: while event flag 1189201 is on, text 411107 is shown instead.

Fields.Name: Ultimate Art Guide Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text shown on the Ultimate Art page of the hero's controls guide.
